authored_by: this lane, by hand, at the owner's instruction
WHAT_THIS_IS: A MOCKUP. Every Hebrew string below was typed by hand from memory. None of it was copied from any text this project holds, none of it traces to a record, and none of it is a reading. It exists to show what each part of the frame LOOKS LIKE when it works, because the books that carry these marks are not published and one of them is not held at all.
WHY_FROM_MEMORY_IS_SAID_OUT_LOUD: A mark shown alone is a glyph; a mark shown inside a passage is the mark doing its work, which is what was asked for. Passages mean real verses, and typing a real verse from memory is exactly the thing this project refuses everywhere else. It is permitted here and nowhere else, and the pointing and cantillation may differ from any given edition. Nothing on this page may be cited, quoted as our text, or compared against a manuscript. When these books build, these drawings come down.
WHY_IT_BREAKS_THE_RULE: The serve law says the pipeline decides and gates are the only judges, and this project does not ship proofs of concept. The owner set that rule and the owner suspended it here, for this page only, and said so plainly. What is not suspended is that a reader can tell the difference: every demonstration is fenced, labelled as typed, and refused a licence chip, because a licence chip over a typed string would be the one lie this site cannot afford.

demonstrations.title: written one way, read another

passage.before: וַיְדַבְּרוּ הַכַּשְׂדִּים לַמֶּלֶךְ אֲרָמִית מַלְכָּא לְעָלְמִין חֱיִי אֱמַר חֶלְמָא
passage.english: Then the Chaldeans spoke to the king in Aramaic: O king, live forever — tell the dream to your servants, and we will declare the meaning.

demonstrations.the_card_says: One word block, one card, two branches. Selecting a half underlines that half in the line and shows that half's English only — one English at a time, and neither is chosen for the reader. The rest of the verse does not move.
demonstrations.key: keyed — one key per branch, delimiters stripped
demonstrations.blocks_the_real_thing: This site holds Daniel and cannot build it: 332 of its surfaces carry literal HTML markup where the text should be.

demonstrations.title: an open section — the next begins on a new line

passage.before: וַיֹּאמַר יְהוָה מִצִּיּוֹן יִשְׁאָג וּמִירוּשָׁלִַם יִתֵּן קוֹלוֹ וְאָבְלוּ נְאוֹת הָרֹעִים וְיָבֵשׁ רֹאשׁ הַכַּרְמֶל
passage.english: And he said: the LORD roars from Zion and utters his voice from Jerusalem; the pastures of the shepherds mourn, and the top of Carmel withers.

demonstrations.the_card_says: The word — petuchah, open — and what it does: this section ends here, and the next begins on a fresh line. If the reader cannot give the break its line, the card says so in plain English rather than drawing nothing.
demonstrations.key: unkeyed — the letter here abbreviates a word and is not an occurrence of that letter
demonstrations.blocks_the_real_thing: Amos is held for the same markup defect. Eight books that do arrive clean arrived flattened, with the marks already gone.

demonstrations.title: a closed section — the next begins after a gap, same line

passage.before: לַכֹּל זְמָן וְעֵת לְכָל חֵפֶץ תַּחַת הַשָּׁמָיִם
passage.english: To everything there is a season, and a time to every purpose under heaven. — A time to be born, and a time to die.

demonstrations.the_card_says: The word — setumah, closed — and what it does: this section ends, and the next begins on the same line, after a gap. A reader that draws this the same as an open section has erased a distinction the scribe made, and has to say which one it cannot honor.
demonstrations.blocks_the_real_thing: Ecclesiastes is held for the markup defect: 40 of its surfaces carry literal markup.

demonstrations.title: two marks bracketing a passage set apart

passage.site: וַיְהִי בִּנְסֹעַ הָאָרֹן וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה קוּמָה יְהוָה וְיָפֻצוּ אֹיְבֶיךָ וְיָנֻסוּ מְשַׂנְאֶיךָ מִפָּנֶיךָ וּבְנֻחֹה יֹאמַר שׁוּבָה יְהוָה רִבְבוֹת אַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
passage.english: And when the ark set out, Moses said: Arise, O LORD, and let your enemies be scattered, and let those who hate you flee before you. And when it rested he said: Return, O LORD, to the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel.

demonstrations.the_card_says: The mark's name, and what the tradition says with it: this passage stands apart. Whether a mark opens, closes, or stands alone is recorded — in Psalm 107 these stand singly, here two of them bracket the passage — and no partner is demanded.
demonstrations.key: unkeyed — this is a punctuation character, not the letter nun
demonstrations.blocks_the_real_thing: Seven of these are in the body. Numbers is one of the eight books that arrived flattened, so the copy we hold has none of them.

demonstrations.title: one word, or the words it stands for

passage.before: בְּכָל מָקוֹם שֶׁאַתָּה מוֹצֵא גְּדֻלָּתוֹ שֶׁל
passage.english: In every place where you find his greatness, there you find his humility.

options.reading: the abbreviation as written, defined as itself

cells.english: the Holy One, blessed be He

options.reading: the words it stands for, each defined separately

demonstrations.the_card_says: An abbreviation is an ordinary COMPspan with two options, not a special case. Selecting the second does not change one letter of what is printed — the line still reads as the source wrote it. The lattice chooses what gets DEFINED, never what gets DISPLAYED, exactly as with written/read.
demonstrations.what_needs_attesting: not the words — each is attested elsewhere in the corpus and the cell points at it — but the MAPPING, that these letters stand for those words.
demonstrations.blocks_the_real_thing: Nothing. This one works on the published site today; it is shown here beside the others so the set can be read together.

demonstrations.title: the book's own count of itself, at the end of the book
demonstrations.at: the last line of a book

passage.after: חצי הספר בפסוקים · חצי הספר בתיבות · חצי הספר באותיות
passage.english: The total of the verses of the book — the midpoint of the book by verses · by words · by letters.

demonstrations.why_three_midpoints: because they land in different places.
demonstrations.the_card_says: That this is not a word of the book, and what the scribes recorded here — then the ordinary card beneath it. The banner stands above a normal card, never instead of one.
demonstrations.counts: OFF — these are excluded from every count the book reports, or the total disagrees with the masorah's own figure and the fault is charged to the scribe
demonstrations.key: keyed, and the only OFF kind that is — these are ordinary Hebrew words meaning what they say
demonstrations.why_no_numbers_are_shown: Because the honest states are NOT_HELD, HELD_UNCOUNTED, VERIFIED and CONTRADICTED, and HELD_UNCOUNTED may not be cited anywhere a reader can see. A figure typed here from memory would be citing an assumption twice over. This is the only mark that makes a checkable claim, so recording it is not attesting it — the half has to be counted.
demonstrations.blocks_the_real_thing: Nobody holds it. The end-of-book masorah is missing from every Tanakh stream either lane has.
